# Guards

Things that must **never** be done. They are loaded in every session and re-injected word for word after a compaction. A guard can only be added, changed or removed with the owner's agreement ([[kb-rules]]). When a task seems to need breaking one: stop and ask the owner.

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-indexes.py from each note's description: edit the notes, not this file. -->

## Notes

- [[collaboration]] — Never act without the owner: approvals, asking, one step at a time, recording decisions, no pushing, English only.
- [[host-safety]] — Never harm the developer's PC: no host installs or builds, everything in the project folder, VMs only.
- [[legal]] — Never redistribute restricted components, ship NC/ND assets, use Pegasus or third-party logos, scrape, or skip credits.
- [[product-invariants]] — What OwneetOS must never become: mouse required, Guide bound by apps, bloat, own server, hard-coded text or colours.
- [[secrets-and-signing]] — Never touch private keys or passphrases; never distribute unsigned builds.
- [[user-data]] — Never endanger the user's disks: BitLocker, erasing, dirty NTFS, moving games.
